_note: Nguon duy nhat cho moi tham so cua he thong. KHONG hardcode lai trong code Python.
_ghi_chu_prefix: Prefix 'huit/ak_majespecter/gate/' la LUA CHON CO CHU DICH, khong doi sang MSSV: tren broker cong cong, mot chuoi ngau nhien kho doan hon MSSV (MSSV co dinh dang co dinh, de tra cuu). Prefix chi de tranh trung topic voi nguoi khac, KHONG phai bien phap bao mat (xem docs/BAO_CAO_KY_THUAT.md muc 7.2). Doi prefix bat buoc dan lai firmware len Wokwi VA import lai flow Node-RED.

mqtt._ghi_chu_broker_rieng: false = broker.hivemq.com:1883 cong cong (nhu cu). true = broker rieng trong muc broker_rieng: TLS cong 8883 + moi chuong trinh mot tai khoan, broker phan quyen theo topic. Huong dan: docs/BROKER_RIENG_TLS.md. Bat true thi PHAI doi ca firmware (firmware/secrets.h) va flow Node-RED (middleware/flows_broker_rieng.json) cung luc.

thresholds._nguon_min_confidence: Chon ngay 31/10 bang gia lap may trang thai tren du doan out-of-fold (notebook Buoc 7b, eval_metrics.json -> nguong_de_xuat): nguong nho nhat ma so burst bi chap nhan SAI <= 3%. Gia tri 0.45 truoc do la ha tay tam thoi vi model cu chi tu tin 0.45-0.54. Neu thay giu tay qua lau moi nhan, co the ha xuong 0.7 (doi lai: sai 5/76 burst thay vi 2/76).

secret._giai_thich: palm(7C) -> ok(4D) -> fist(3A). Ma that duoc giu trong flow context cua Node-RED (hang MA_MAC_DINH trong middleware/flows.json phai khop).
secret._ly_do_doi_ma: Doi ngay 31/10 tu 7CE13A (palm -> victory -> fist) sang 7C4D3A. Can cu: kiem dinh cheo 5 fold chia theo burst (eval_metrics.json), khong phai validation ro ri cu. Tren du lieu tu thu victory chi dung 58.1% (bi doc thanh point_up 19.3%, thanh none 14.3%); gia lap may trang thai o nguong 0.8 chi chap nhan duoc 7/14 burst victory trong 2 giay, trong khi ok duoc 12/13, palm 13/14, fist 9/12, va ca ba khong co burst nao bi chap nhan sai. Tren HaGRID (nguoi la) ca bon lop deu tren 94%, nen ly do doi la do dung tren tay nguoi dung that. Khong dung thumb_up vi thumb_up -> fist 14.9%. Khong gian ma van 216 to hop.
